verdict.rationale: The docs say the hosted platform can be run from 'a coding agent with your API key', and they publish an agent-readable llms.txt (confirmed live by probe) with agent-directed guidance such as checking billing before spending allowance. That lets a user drive Cactus through natural language via an external agent, but the product has no first-party natural-language command interface of its own. Community reports of Needle demos misfiring on indirect phrasing concern the model's tool-calling accuracy inside demo apps, not operating Cactus itself, so they do not create a dispute here. missing for 10: native natural-language control of the platform or CLI, documented agent workflows beyond a one-line mention, and hands-on corroboration of agent-driven operation.
